slots.title: Wall Street freaked out Friday, but VIX and bitcoin trades say the fear may fade Monday.
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Wall Street's fear gauge, the VIX index, spiked on Friday as stocks dropped. History says Friday panics usually fade on Monday. Seasonality and calm bitcoin markets suggest the same.
